RingFlex -- the placement boundary (C3) and the envelope (C2)
============================================================

A. The seam (C3 section 3): closed downward, refused upward

  PASS  a .wflow invoking a ZQL flow is lawful
  PASS  INVOKED_BY at declaration position is refused
  PASS    and it cites the contract, not just the grammar
  PASS  CALLED_BY in body position is refused under the same code
  PASS  declaring a FLOW is refused as FLOW_IS_ZQL

B. The C2 v1.1 envelope, on every diagnostic this court can emit

  PASS  the fixture suite produces diagnostics to judge
  PASS  every code matches the contract's format
  PASS  every severity is on the closed two-rung ladder
  PASS  every message is non-empty prose
  PASS  every span names a file and a line >= 0
  PASS  every cite is kind:value in the four binding kinds
  PASS  every diagnostic declares language wflow
  PASS  the emitted JSON parses as JSON
  PASS    and holds one object per diagnostic
  PASS    and survives a re-emit through the family's WRITER
  PASS    and the re-emitted document is still the same document
  PASS    and the diagnostics value is still an ARRAY, not an object
  PASS  a clean run still emits JSON the family's reader can read
  PASS    and CARRIES the diagnostics key with nothing in it
  PASS    and that key holds exactly zero diagnostics
  PASS  a clean run survives a re-emit and KEEPS the empty key
  PASS    and it is still an EMPTY ARRAY, not an empty object

C. C3 section 3.2: every INVOKES resolves to flow:<name>

  PASS  the world fixture loads
  PASS  every INVOKES of the lawful workflow resolves
  PASS  a world missing one flow refuses exactly one step
  PASS    and the refusal names the step, which is the gate's real requirement
  PASS    and it lands on the step's own line, not file-wide
  PASS  a world missing the COMPENSATED_BY flow refuses exactly one step
  PASS    and the refusal names the compensating flow, not the invoked one
  PASS    and it lands on the compensating step's own line
  PASS    and it cites the article that was amended to say so
  PASS  the complete world still resolves everything, compensation included
  PASS  the file-local court still judges this file clean on its own
  PASS  no world at all is a warning, not a refusal

D. What this court contributes back to the world (C1)

  PASS  one process symbol per file, and only one
  PASS    named for the workflow
  PASS  one calls ref per invocation, plus the compensating flow
  PASS  every ref is a calls into a flow: symbol
  PASS  this court declares no flow symbols -- ZQL's court owns those
E. What jsonlib's writer does, measured here

  PASS  a pair of string-then-number COLLAPSES to an object
  PASS    and a pair of NUMBERS survives as an array
  PASS    and an array of objects -- this court's own shape -- survives
  PASS  booleans and null return as STRINGS, so this court emits neither
  PASS    and the court's own document contains no bare true/false/null


---------------------------------------------------
44 passed, 0 failed

GATE: the seam is closed downward in both positions, every
      diagnostic conforms to C2 v1.1, and every INVOKES
      resolves to a C1 flow symbol or is named as unresolved.
